{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Run CI for R using https://eddelbuettel.github.io/r-ci/

name: ci

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

env:
  _R_CHECK_FORCE_SUGGESTS_: "false"
  R_LIBS_USER: ${{ github.workspace }}/.R-library

jobs:
  ci:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          #- {os: macOS-latest}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest}
          #- {os: ubuntu-24.04-arm}

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Cache R packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.R_LIBS_USER }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-R-${{ hashFiles('DESCRIPTION', 'renv.lock') }}

      - name: Setup
        uses: eddelbuettel/github-actions/r-ci@master

      - name: Dependencies
        run: ./run.sh install_all

      - name: Test
        run: ./run.sh run_tests

      - name: Logs
        run: ./run.sh dump_logs
        if: failure()

      - name: Coverage
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        run: ./run.sh coverage
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency cache). The workflow repeatedly fetches R dependencies on every run (Dependencies step) and CI history shows repeated runs, satisfying the cache preconditions. Added an actions/cache@v4 step before installation that restores/saves the R package library (R_LIBS_USER) keyed on runner OS and the dependency manifest (DESCRIPTION/renv.lock), preserving all build/test steps, the matrix, fail-fast (matrix outcomes are required), and existing secrets/permissions. No privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access added. Supported by measured CI-workflow cache evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
